dct_title_s: Asia_China : Kwantung Peninsula. Approaches to Ryojun Ko (Port Arthur)
dct_description_sm: Depths shown by soundings, relief by contours and spot heights.
Shows depths, shoals, reefs, drainage, coastal buildings, city plans.
Facilities, such as "Radio masts," and "Consp. bldg. (white)."
"Japanese Chart No. 358, British Admiralty Chart No. 1236."
